plan: Given my private value of $3, my strategy is to minimize losses since winning the bid would not be profitable. Bidding above my value could result in a loss if I win. Therefore, I will place a low bid to avoid winning, as the cost of winning would exceed the value of the prize.

Given my private value of $45, I aim to maximize profit by bidding just above what I estimate the others might bid, without exceeding my value. The optimal bid should be slightly above the midpoint of the range to outbid others while ensuring profit. I will bid $30, assuming others value the prize lower than $45 and to avoid overpaying if winning.

Since this is the only round, I aim to maximize profit by winning the auction. My private value is $48, so I should bid close to this value to ensure a win without overbidding. I will bid $47.9 to increase my chances of winning while paying the least possible amount, as the highest I can pay is $47.9 if the other bids are lower. This strategy balances the risk of overpayment against the likelihood of winning the prize.
